name: Shibam multistorey mud-brick city
description: Shibam combined sun-dried mud-brick tower houses with a dense fortified street grid.

impact.note: One walled town's tall mud-brick houses, a striking local use of an existing material, with no known successors beyond its valley.

date.label: Sixteenth century CE
date.basis: The stated range or year applies to the described evidence or documentary event; it does not establish invention.

events.statement: UNESCO describes a sixteenth-century walled city with mud-brick tower houses and a rectilinear street grid.

caveats: Individual buildings have different histories; the city superseded an earlier settlement partly destroyed by flood in 1532–33.
